title: Interlaced rosette of the Moulay Ismail mosque (Fès)
subtitle: Moulay Ismail mosque, Fès

given.O: The centre of the star inside the large rosette.

construction.note: The finished design was read from Wichmann’s MOR0331 drawing, an interlace of bands, by their centre lines. Its tile corners were snapped to the square-root-of-two grid in star-radius units. The unit-star opening is shared with the other Moroccan reconstructions. After it every line, the tile’s sides too, is drawn through a crossing of earlier lines and turned round O. The drawing gives no steps; we devised the construction.
construction.changes: The compass steps, their order and the named points are ours. The lines are the centre lines of the drawing’s bands; the over-and-under weave is not drawn. The colours follow Wichmann’s drawing: black, red and green, in the Tétouan palette, whose dark navy stands for his black; the bands themselves are not pieces. Wade’s photo MOR 0331 was not checked.

credits.source: Tiling Search, data189/MOR0331: Moulay Ismail mosque, Fès
credits.creator: Brian Wichmann
credits.note: Read from his finished drawing, not construction instructions. His references are David Wade’s photo MOR 0331, the Moulay Ismail mosque, Fès (patterninislamicart.com), and Wichmann and Wade, Islamic Design: a Mathematical Approach (2017), figure 9.11.

steps.text: Draw a horizontal straight line through O and A. Draw a circle with centre O through A.

Draw a vertical line through O. It crosses the circle at C and D. The horizontal line crosses the circle at B on the left. Draw a vertical line through A. Draw a horizontal line through C. They cross at E. Draw a straight line through O and E. Draw a line through O at 90° to line OE. The circle crosses the four lines through O at S1 to S8.
Draw the star at O as two squares.

parts.text: Draw a straight line through S1 and S3, S3 and S5, S5 and S7, and S7 and S1. Draw each line long, beyond the circle.
Draw a straight line through S2 and S4, S4 and S6, S6 and S8, and S8 and S2. Draw each line long, beyond the circle.

steps.text: The line from S7 to S1 crosses the line from S2 to S4 at P1. Draw a vertical line through P1. Turn it round O by 45°, seven times.
The line from S2 to S4 crosses the vertical line through P1, turned by 315°, at P2. Draw a vertical line through P2. Turn it round O by 45°, seven times.
The line from S3 to S5 crosses the vertical line through P2 at P3. Draw a horizontal line through P3. Turn it round O by 45°, seven times.
The line from S7 to S1 crosses the horizontal line through P3 at P4. Draw a vertical line through P4. Turn it round O by 45°, seven times.
The line from S3 to S5 crosses the vertical line through P4 at P5. Draw a horizontal line through P5. Turn it round O by 45°, seven times.

The horizontal line through P3 crosses the horizontal line through P5, turned by 315°, at P6. The line from S2 to S4 crosses the horizontal line through P3, turned by 225°, at P7. Draw a vertical line through P6. Draw a vertical line through P7. Turn the new lines round O by 45°, seven times.
The line from S3 to S5 crosses the vertical line through P7 at P8. Draw a horizontal line through P8. Turn it round O by 45°, seven times.

The line from S2 to S4 crosses the vertical line through P4, turned by 315°, at P9. The line from S7 to S1 crosses the horizontal line through P8 at P10. Draw a vertical line through P9. Draw a vertical line through P10. Turn the new lines round O by 90°, three times.
The line from S3 to S5 crosses the vertical line through P9 at P11. Draw a horizontal line through P11. Turn it round O by 45°, seven times.
The line from S7 to S1 crosses the horizontal line through P11 at P12. Draw a vertical line through P12. Turn it round O by 45°, seven times.

The line from S2 to S4 crosses the horizontal line through P8, turned by 225°, at P13. The line from S2 to S4 crosses the horizontal line through P11, turned by 315°, at P14. Draw a vertical line through P13. Draw a vertical line through P14. Turn the new lines round O by 90°, three times.
The line from S3 to S5 crosses the vertical line through P13 at P15. Draw a horizontal line through P15. Turn it round O by 45°, seven times.

The line from S7 to S1 crosses the horizontal line through P15 at P16. The horizontal line through C crosses the line from S5 to S7 at P17. Draw a vertical line through P16. Draw a line through P17 parallel to line OE. Draw a line through P2 at 90° to line OE. Turn the new lines round O by 90°, three times.

The line from S2 to S4 crosses the vertical line through P10 at P18. The vertical line through P2 crosses the horizontal line through P15 at P19. The horizontal line through P5 crosses the vertical line through P16 at P20. Draw a line through P18 parallel to line OE. Draw a line through P19 at 90° to line OE. Draw a line through P20 at 90° to line OE. Turn the new lines round O by 90°, three times.

The vertical line through P9 crosses the horizontal line through P15 at P21. The horizontal line through P11 crosses the vertical line through P16 at P22. The vertical line through P14 crosses the horizontal line through P15 at P23. Draw a line through P21 at 90° to line OE. Draw a line through P22 at 90° to line OE. Draw a line through P23 at 90° to line OE. Turn the new lines round O by 90°, three times.
The vertical line through P1, turned by 315°, crosses the horizontal line through P15 at P24. Draw a line through P24 at 90° to line OE. Turn it round O by 90°, three times.

The horizontal line through O crosses the vertical line through P12, turned by 45°, at T. Draw a vertical line through T. Turn it round O by 90°, three times. The four lines make a square with corners K1, K2, K3 and K4.
Join K1, K2, K3 and K4 to mark the tile that repeats.

ink.text: Ink the lines picked out in orange. They are the middles of the interlaced bands.

pattern.text: Put copies of the square tile side by side. A rosette sits at the centre of every tile.
